early_entries.name: baseline ×0.25
early_entries.what: Organizer ONNX GRU baseline, outputs scaled ×0.25 so the ±2 clip stops biting. Starting point.

early_entries.name: ab18_wmse_struct
early_entries.what: Own GRU128 with |y|-weighted MSE and structural aux heads (spread, branch, class), trained on train only. Better on clean validation (+0.005) but worse on the public test: valid-like data matters.

early_entries.name: final_tv_e2
early_entries.what: Same GRU trained on train + validation, 2 epochs. First real gain over the baseline (+0.0045).

early_entries.name: blend_base_final_tv
early_entries.what: 0.5 GRU + 0.5 rescaled baseline. Blending with the organizer model added +0.0021.

team_entries.name: candA
team_entries.what: Two GRU256 members, head-only fine-tune. A runtime governor dropped one member mid-run, so it scored as a single GRU256.

team_entries.name: candB
team_entries.what: GRU256 + 2×GRU128, head-only fine-tune (full fine-tune erased the width gain), 1/3 each.

team_entries.name: candC
team_entries.what: Distilled GRU256 (targets 0.5·y + 0.5·teacher) + GRU128 s3 + GRU128 s4 + chunk-500 GRU128, C++ fp16 engine.

team_entries.name: V1 (NaiveBayes best)
team_entries.what: candC's parents with a 2-epoch head fine-tune. Team best.

team_entries.name: V2
team_entries.what: candC members retrained with validation weighted ×3 in the parents. −0.0029: over-weighting validation hurts.

team_entries.name: V3
team_entries.what: candC members with parents trained on train only. −0.0011: 1× validation in the parents is right.

historical_forecasts.name: RSP2_f32 (not uploaded)
historical_forecasts.what: Market-class routing: classes 0–2 keep the incumbent members; class 3 averages each trunk's pre-fine-tune head with its head-only fine-tune head. Holdout +0.0012; preregistered folds 2/3 +0.0003.

historical_forecasts.name: S4D_i16 (not uploaded)
historical_forecasts.what: Since GRU128 trunk + distilled GRU256 trunk (our own distillation from the since pair), each with merged parent + fine-tune heads, own int16 Rust engine (~48 min). 4 clean folds +0.0018, holdout +0.0016.

changes.baseline ×0.25: Organizer ONNX GRU baseline, outputs scaled ×0.25 so the ±2 clip stops biting. Starting point.
changes.ab18_wmse_struct: Own GRU128 with |y|-weighted MSE and structural auxiliary heads, train-only. Historical clean-validation improvement failed to transfer to the public test.
changes.final_tv_e2: Same GRU trained on train + validation, 2 epochs. First real gain over the baseline (+0.0045).
changes.blend_base_final_tv: 0.5 GRU + 0.5 rescaled baseline. Blending with the organizer model added +0.0021.
changes.final_s4_base35: New recipe: rows weighted by a learned scoring-mask propensity (p²+0.03), true validation masks, next-change aux head, seed 4; 0.65 GRU + 0.35 baseline.
changes.final_s4ft_base35: Fine-tune on validation with the true scoring masks. Public +0.0014; the historical local forecast understated this particular gain.
changes.final_s4lpft_base35: LP-FT: fine-tune the head first, then the full network. +0.0001, as forecast.
changes.final_ema4_lpft_base35: EMA mean-teacher (weight averaging + consistency) over 4 epochs. +0.0017.
changes.final_since2_gclp: Since-event row weighting (rows right after a quote move count more, τ = 32), two seeds, pooled-correlation (gcorr) LP-FT, baseline dropped, native Rust engine. Personal best through September 30.
changes.final_mixed_ema6_shared: EMA-6 member mixed with the since seed-4 member. Public score fell by 0.0006 from the earlier best; evidence against this tested combination.
changes.final_ema6_shared: Two EMA-6 members. Public score fell by 0.0010 from the earlier best; does not prove every longer EMA schedule is harmful.
changes.R4D_routed_since_d256: Market-class routed combination of the since GRU128 and distilled GRU256, with fixed merged parent/fine-tuned heads. Public 0.6638.
changes.S4D_since_d256: Since GRU128 + distilled GRU256, each with merged parent/head outputs, int16 Rust engine. Scored 0.6633; later single D256 scored 0.6641.
changes.D256_single_distilled: Single distilled GRU256, alpha 0.5, equal parent and head-only correlation fine-tune. Dropped the older GRU128 blend members; reached 0.6641.
changes.D07s3_distilled_alpha07: Distillation alpha 0.7, seed 3, same complete parent/head procedure. Public 0.6635, below the alpha-0.5 incumbent.
changes.D07s4_distilled_alpha07_seed4: Second final alpha-0.7 seed. Public 0.6639; seed variation did not recover the alpha-0.5 public score.
changes.D256_reference_repeat: Repeat fixed distilled D256 reference. Public 0.6641 again; 37m37s.
changes.D256_single_q16x: Same D256 model with q16x native precision. Public 0.6641, 32m17s: successful deployment variant, no score gain.
changes.TE07s3_teacher_ensemble_public: Student taught by the same-family teacher ensemble, alpha 0.7. Public 0.6636; this configuration lost to single-teacher D256.
changes.chunk500_ensemble_public: Three-member GRU128 chunk/EMA blend. Public 0.6633, 39m21s; more members did not improve this score.
changes.c20261004_combo_s3_i16: Full-data Muon + chunk1000 + stopped-bootstrap horizon8 /alpha0.5 GRU256; fixed epoch3, head-only correlation fine-tune, equal parent/head. Public +0.0014 over D256.
changes.c20261004_combo_parent_s3_i16: Same fixed seed-3 combo parent, before the final head procedure. Public 0.6641, 33m57s: ties the earlier complete D256 public point.
changes.c20261004_combo_head_s3_i16: Fixed seed-3 combo after head-only fine-tuning, head endpoint alone. Public 0.6654, 34m1s; +0.0013 versus parent, 0.0001 below the equal mixture.
changes.c20261004_combo_s4_i16: Second full-data combo parent seed; fixed epoch3 plus the same head procedure and equal parent/head. Public 0.6660, 37m7s; +0.0005 over seed3. Target reached at displayed precision.
